history.summary: A spacious 1,076 sqft 2BR 99LH in D23 Bukit Batok/Gombak (Hilltop Grove, TOP 2002) at $1.148M / $1,067 PSF — slightly under the $1,085 URA median, with a reliable 47-transaction base showing a solid 4.35%/yr appreciation. The drag is the 1.68km / 20-min walk to Bukit Gombak MRT and a 99LH now ~24 years into its term.
history.rating_rationale: This is the best-supported value case in the batch's OCR leasehold cohort: 47 URA transactions (the most reliable series here), 4.35%/yr appreciation slightly above OCR baseline, and asking $1,067 PSF just below the $1,085 median — fairly priced and well-evidenced. The low $1.148M quantum gives a deep, HDB-upgrader buyer pool. Offsetting: the unit is 1.68km from MRT (poor connectivity, bus-dependent), it is a 99LH from 2002 (~75yrs left, lease decay accelerating over a 5-7yr hold), and the 1,076 sqft "2BR" is oversized so PSF efficiency is soft. Fairly priced with good data but no growth catalyst — Neutral.

99-year leasehold from 2002 — lease decay over the hold period
